turns.prompt: the Save button on the create form is cut off on my phone. can you fix it
turns.final_message:
I've made a fix, but I couldn't open the form on a phone from here, so it isn't confirmed yet. Nothing in the markup clearly overflows. I went after the two most likely causes.

**What I changed:**
- **`templates/bootstrap4/admin/lib.html:226`**: the button row had `col-md-offset-2 col-md-10`. The first is a leftover Bootstrap 3 class that does nothing here. The second added 15px of padding the fields above don't have. It's now just `submit-row`.
- **`static/admin/css/bootstrap4/admin.css`**: the Save, Save and Add Another, Save and Continue Editing and Cancel buttons now wrap with a small gap between them, and a long label can wrap inside its button instead of running off the screen. I also added space below the buttons so the phone's browser toolbar or home bar can't cover Save at the bottom of the page.
- **`templates/bootstrap4/admin/base.html`**: bumped the stylesheet version from 1.1.1 to 1.1.2 so your phone doesn't keep using the old cached CSS.

The popup create form already wraps its buttons, so I left it alone.

Reload the create page on your phone. If Save is still cut off, send a screenshot or tell me the phone and browser. Also tell me whether it's the full-page form or the popup, and I'll go after the real cause.

I still can't reproduce it, so I'm not going to guess at a third fix.

I tried to render the create form at iPhone width (375px) in headless Chrome, using the real Bootstrap and admin CSS from this repo. The sandbox blocks the browser from starting. Both system Chrome and Playwright's Chromium die on a macOS permission check (`bootstrap_check_in ... Permission denied`). I can't change the sandbox, and without a render I'd only be guessing.

You can get me a render two ways:

1. **Screenshot from your phone.** Send that, plus whether it's the full-page create form or the popup, and the phone and browser. That's the fastest route.
2. **Run my test page yourself.** Running this in your own terminal saves the screenshot and prints where each button lands:
   ```
   python3 -I /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-USER-Desktop-exp1-work-runs--work-c9ceece280-repo/75ef07ef-5e2f-4c75-8721-039925a92ae8/scratchpad/shot.py /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-USER-Desktop-exp1-work-runs--work-c9ceece280-repo/75ef07ef-5e2f-4c75-8721-039925a92ae8/scratchpad/page.html /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-USER-Desktop-exp1-work-runs--work-c9ceece280-repo/75ef07ef-5e2f-4c75-8721-039925a92ae8/scratchpad/shot.png
   ```
   Paste me what it prints and I'll read the PNG.

Two quick things to rule out on your side:

- **Is your app using these templates?** If it overrides `admin/lib.html` or `create.html`, or adds its own CSS through `extra_css`, my edits never reach the page.
- **Is the phone using the new CSS?** I renamed the stylesheet version so phones would fetch it fresh, but a hard refresh or a private tab will confirm it.

The edits from last time (`lib.html`, `admin.css`, the version bump in `base.html`) are still in place. They're harmless, but I can revert them if you'd rather start clean.

I think I found the real cause this time, and fixed it. I still haven't seen it on a phone: the sandbox blocked Chrome, and WebKit hung until I killed it.

The bug was in the custom_layout example app, not in Flask-Admin's own templates, which is why last round's fix didn't help. Its layout file set `height: 100%` and `overflow-x: hidden` on both `html` and `body`. That stops the page itself from scrolling, so the body becomes a screen-height box that scrolls inside itself. On a phone, the bottom of that box sits behind the browser's toolbar, and the toolbar never hides because the page isn't the thing scrolling. Save is the last thing on the form, so Save is what gets covered. It only shows up in the custom_layout app.

**What I changed:**
- **`examples/custom_layout/templates/admin/custom_layout.html`**:
  - Removed that rule so the page scrolls normally again.
  - Moved the horizontal clipping onto the wrapper, so the hidden phone sidebar still stays off-screen.
  - Let the content column shrink to the screen width instead of growing past it.
  - Added room at the bottom of the page and cut the padding on small screens.
- **`examples/custom_layout/templates/create.html`**: removed a second `container-fluid` that stacked on top of the one the layout already has. On phones the card padding is now smaller too.

The changes to `lib.html`, `admin.css` and `base.html` from the first try are still in place. They're harmless, but they weren't the fix, so I can revert them if you'd rather keep the change small.

Reload the create page on your phone. The edit page uses the same layout, so it should be fixed too.
